newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ingles Markets lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ingles Markets lowered.

text.p: Smith Barney said analyst Gary Giblen downgraded Ingles Markets Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- on Friday the company said it expects primary per-share earnings in the third quarter ended June 29 to range between $0.21 and $0.23.
-- the consensus earnings estimate for the quarter had been $0.30 a share, according to First Call.
-- in a report Giblen said he cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate on the company to $0.97 from $1.15 and dropped fiscal 1998 to $1.08 from $1.28.
